text:
jess: Heads up — master CI red since ~10:12am. ~40 integration failures, many with mock-redis connection resets/timeouts. https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/12345

infra-bot: Pipeline failed: master @main — https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/12345. Failed jobs: integ-redis, integ-cache, integ-1. Logs: /artifacts/pipeline-12345/*

sam: Seeing it too. Reran integ-redis job once, still failing :eyes:

jess: Reran twice, same. Failures show `ConnectionRefusedError` and the mock-redis container gets OOMKilled. Snippet from job logs:
```
[2026-03-17T10:12:45Z] redis | *** FATAL CONFIG FILE ERROR ***
[2026-03-17T10:12:45Z] redis | Can't allocate memory for script cache
[2026-03-17T10:12:46Z] redis | Killed
[2026-03-17T10:12:46Z] tests | ERROR tests/test_cache.py::test_cache_invalidation - ConnectionRefusedError
```

renato: Pulled full job stdout from runner 7: see docker daemon message: 
```
Mar 17 10:12:44 runner systemd[1]: docker.service: Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL
Mar 17 10:12:44 kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 1234 (redis-server) score 987 or sacrifice child
Mar 17 10:12:44 kernel: Killed process 1234 (redis-server) total-vm:512000kB, anon-rss:450000kB
```

qa-jen: Failing tests (top):
- tests/test_cache.py::test_cache_invalidation
- tests/test_throttle.py::test_redis_backoff
- tests/test_session.py::test_session_reconnect
All errors are connection timeouts or resets. Repro locally when mock redis has <512MB.

oncall-rotation: Quick triage checklist: was there any CI image change or a mock-redis image update in the last hour? Can someone bisect to a green commit? @renato any infra deploys?

renato: No infra deploys in the window. Runner nodes have had memory pressure earlier today. We've seen docker OOM on the self-hosted runners before when many integ jobs run in parallel. My hypothesis: parallelism + mock redis memory = OOM. Suggest temporary mitigation: bump integ job memory to 4Gi or reduce parallelism. I'll open infra PR ASAP.

jess: If so, can we rerun with reduced parallelism as a quick mitigation? @sam can you patch pipeline to `max-parallel: 2` for integ jobs and retry a run?

sam: On it. Pushed a quick pipeline change: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/12346 (set max-parallel=2 for integ-*). Kicking rerun now.

infra-bot: Rerun started: pipeline 12346 (config patch). Triggered by sam.

sam: Rerun finished — integ jobs that were failing are now passing ✅. Looks like reducing concurrency avoided OOM. Will leave monitoring for 30m.

qa-jen: Confirmed local repro: increasing mock-redis memory to 768m avoids the failures when running the full test-suite with docker-compose. Leaving a note in the ticket.

renato: Opened infra PR to increase integ job memory and add a healthcheck + restart policy for mock redis container: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/789 — includes runner resources + optional `restart: on-failure`.

jess: Great. Marking this as infra-caused flaky. I added a quick comment on the failing PR to re-open if it flaps again. Thanks everyone for the fast triage :thumbsup:

sam: FYI I'll leave the reduced parallelism config on for 1h, then revert when infra PR lands.

oncall-rotation: Noted. If it flaps again, ping the oncall channel and include a link to the failing job artifacts.

jess: Closing thread for now. Reopen if it resurfaces.
